title: GCC 15 warnings need a Gaia baseline policy
body: A fresh Release Gaia unit build on GCC 15.2 failed before the compiled-mode change because src/CMakeLists.txt enables -Werror while existing headers trigger -Werror=stringop-overflow at include/gaia/ecs/component_cache_item.h:749 and -Werror=array-bounds at include/gaia/cnt/impl/sarray_impl.h:162. The lane had to pass -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-Wno-error=stringop-overflow -Wno-error=array-bounds" to establish a green baseline. The facade/tooling should encode a supported compiler-version warning policy or repair the warnings so every lane does not hand-author this exception.

title: Gaia unit build admission needs a memory profile
body: The first fresh Release configure/build through the live queue was terminated by MEMORY-CAP-EXCEEDED at 32831MB > 32170MB while generating the default single header and building Gaia unit tests (label cx-gaiacompiled:gaia-baseline-build, log /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1793734146-build-cx-gaiacompiled:gaia-baseline-build.log). The lane had to configure with -DGAIA_GENERATE_SINGLE_HEADER=OFF for the build witness and regenerate the header separately. The build contract should publish a measured memory profile or separate generation/build admission for this target.
